name: – Leire Pajín, Aurelijus Veryga – Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote – Am 138
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: Article5a Preparedness for Climate-related risks 1. This Regulation shall support Member States in strengthening prevention and preparedness for climate-related, multiple and cumulative disasters and emergencies, particularly those caused by climate change as well as those exacerbated by demographic changes. In this regard, the Commission and Member States shall: (a) integrate climate risk assessments and forward-looking climate projections, taking into account their systemic impacts, into national and Union disaster risk management planning; (b) promote the development of prevention and preparedness measures addressing climate-related risks in line with the One Health approach, including extreme weather events, wildfires, droughts, floods, heatwaves and coastal hazards; (c) support the adaptation and climate resilience of civil protection response capacities developed under this Regulation, including rescEU capacities; (d) enhance early warning systems, cross-border risk monitoring and information exchange related to climate induced hazards; (e) strengthen cooperation with relevant Union programmes and agencies contributing to climate adaptation, environmental protection and disaster risk reduction. 2. Capacities supported under this Regulation shall, where appropriate, be designed and maintained in a manner that ensures operational effectiveness under evolving climate and other environmental conditions. 3. The Commission shall facilitate the exchange of best practices and lessons learned on climate resilience and adaptation within the framework of the Knowledge Network.
